AGENDA ITEMS AND ACTIONS
6:00 P.M. - SPECIAL CONCURRENT MEETING

CALL TO ORDER Mayor Ivan Altamirano called the Concurrent Special Meeting to order at 6:09 p.m.

ROLL CALL

PUBLIC COMMENT There were no individuals wishing to address the City Council on any items.




CONSENT CALENDAR

3.. Right-of-Way Use Agreement With the Gateway Cities Council of Governments for Installation, Maintenance, and Operation of the Gateway Cities Regional Fiber Optic Network Within the City’s Boundaries  -  Action: approve as amended (Pass) Moved by Kevin Lainez Hector De La Torre from the Gateway Cities Council of Governments provided a presentation on the item. City Manager Ernie Hernandez also provided additional comments.

1.. First Amendment to the City Manager’s Employment Agreement Action Taken: The City Council adopted Resolution No. 25-60 approving the First Amendment to the employment agreement between the City of Commerce and Ernie Hernandez for City Manager’s services.  

4.. Women and Walls - Art Mural Consideration  -  Action: withdraw

2.. Resolution No. 25-61 and No. 25-62 of the City Council of the City of Commerce, California Approving Compensation and Fringe Benefits Modifications for Executive Management and City Council Action Taken: The City Council adopted Resolution No. 25-61 and No. 25-62 authorizing compensation and fringe benefits for the Executive Management Employees and City Council.  

ADJOURNMENT The meeting adjourned at 8:02 p.m.

Written materials distributed to the City Council are available for public inspection immediately following the posting of this agenda (at least 72 hours prior to a regular City Council meetings) in the City Clerk's Office, at Commerce City Hall, 2535 Commerce Way, Commerce, California, and the Central Library, 5655 Jillson Street, Commerce, California.

Meeting facilities are accessible to persons with disabilities. ln compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, notify the Office of the City Clerk at (323) 722-4805 at least 24 hours prior to the meeting.

SCHEDULED MATTERS

Approval of the Consent Agenda  -  Action: approve (Pass) Moved by Oralia Rebollo
